title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Gender Equitable and Community Resilience programme using a nexus approach in Mambasa, Irumu and Djugu territories in Irumi Province, DRC implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to 4.2: Individuals and communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief towards independence. The activities and objective are access to agricultural inputs; training; knowledge and skills for livelihood resuscitation, wetland and permaculture, seed multiplication, preservation of native seeds; access to village saving and loans to enable those affected by crisis can protect, revitalise and restore their livelihoods. Programmes are in partnership with Club des Volontaires pour l'Appui aux Peuples autochtones (CVAP), Programme Nourriture D'Abord (PNA) and Caritas Wamba.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 4.2Women and men in communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief assistance towards meeting their food and livelihoods needs. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this objective is:- Promote sustainable, resilient approaches to agriculture i.e. the adoption of agroecological practices- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- reduce poverty at a household level for the most marginalised of a community- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys
